type_template_grammar: fixed u8/u32/u64/i1/i32/data_ptr/code_ptr/exception/fenv/stack_mark/journal; typeN binds exactly one admitted execution entity_ref; storage_value=int/raw/float/data_ptr/code_ptr/code_address/vector/array/struct; scalar pointer=data_ptr/code_ptr/code_address; fixed code_ptr remains callable-only
order_input_domain: pinned Clang __ATOMIC constants0..5; consume refines acquire; no unknown upper bits
signature_rules: exact params/results/noundef/portable cc/nonvariadic; no host ABI inference; ABI storage mask/extent checked separately

guarded_value.frontier: validate_and_pin_all_bytes_before_effect; publish complete typed result once
guarded_value.shadow: bytes/poison/undef/pointer origins copied under same backing synchronization
guarded_value.fault: fault leaves destination/result unchanged and retains original operation frontier
guarded_value.lifetime: mapping/object generation checked; all virtual aliases share backing identity

atomic.frontier: one guarded byte+shadow+observed+success transaction, one ticket winner
atomic.shadow: load/exchange preserve observed shadow; store/successful CAS copy desired shadow
atomic.comparison: full_storage or admitted value_mask or llvm_precision; zero poison/undef compared bits per use
atomic.arithmetic: integer modulo precision; poison significant input produces poisoned result; origin cleared except exchange
atomic.progress: lock backed for every size; is_lock_free=false; process/shared backing broker domain
atomic.width: any positive ABI storage size within configured resource quota, not restricted to powers of two or16B

bulk.frontier: validate/pin all spans before first effect; ticket records direction+committed bytes at chunk polls
bulk.shadow: memcpy/memmove copy all shadow; memset transfers raw8 byte poison/undef, clears origins; defined byte clears shadow
bulk.zero: original poison/undef length UB; defined zero length observes no pointer/value except separate argument attributes; memcpy identical spans or disjoint only
bulk.commit: one final result frontier; never repeat already copied chunks; memmove chooses overlap-safe direction

allocation.frontier: publish object identity/address/generation only after full reservation succeeds
allocation.lifetime: thread/activation stack or process heap owner; end/revoke closes admission and drains pins
allocation.initial: uninitialized bytes have undef shadow; calloc defines zero; no host uninitialized bytes
allocation.failure: heap allocation returns null and guest errno ENOMEM; stack resource failure precise resource trap

tls.frontier: stable per-thread module address; copy template/relocations before publishing initialization
tls.callbacks: publish suspended caller and drop runtime locks before guest initialization/destruction
tls.guard: uninitialized/initializing/initialized; same-thread recursion UB; abort retries block-static but namespace throw terminates
tls.raw: tls_address_raw returns preissued TLSbase+u64offset modulo2^64 with exactobject/gen/range, noinit/guestmemoryaccess/allocation/block/trap; everyoffset representable evenoutsidebounds, laterderefs check. LLVM usesoffset0; thread/moduleadmission reserves slots beforepublication.
tls.lease: TLS/initializer/destructor retains exact module generation until thread cleanup

fp.frontier: compute exact destination bits and raised flags; default LLVM operations do not alter guest fenv
fp.constrained: constrained/c_fenv merges sticky flags before enabled trap; result uncommitted on trap
fp.formats: binary16/bfloat16/binary32/binary64/binary128; no host long-double or default fenv substitution
fp.nan: execution candidate exact NaN/signaling/payload/rounding/conversion contract is authoritative

fenv.frontier: INT010rev2 thread-owned source rounding+six flags including explicit-only denorm; source traps0; private VM diagnostics separate IEEEfive
fenv.raise: merge flags before enabled diagnostic trap; no result publication on trap
fenv.migration: restore host environment and install thread guest environment explicitly at every boundary

varargs.frontier: ABI32B list/header, exact promoted nominal type, live thread/activation cookie and full bounds before cursor change
varargs.copy: va_copy duplicates cursor; va_end invalidates; foreign lists require descriptor conversion
varargs.failure: precise guest-UB diagnostic leaves cursor and destination unchanged

nonlocal.frontier: registry-bound logical snapshot with complete typed locals/shadow/allocations/journals/continuation
nonlocal.jump: same process/thread/live activation/generation; zero i32 becomes1; validate cleanup before discarding frames
nonlocal.cleanup: C++ invalid longjmp path is UB; admitted foreign/nonlocal recipes coordinate exact journal cleanup, never Rust unwind

eh.frontier: pure global handler search, then exactly-once reverse committed-subobject cleanup, then selected invoke edge
eh.identity: typed catches use admitted nominal/copy/base/qualification recipes; opaque leases only catch-all/rethrow
eh.ownership: exception owner module/object/type/code retained through exception_ptr/rethrow/catch destruction
eh.private_E: opaque SSA only, no ordinary memory; source exception_ptr8B owner proxy to reserved readonly32B registry object, actual process/object/base/provenance/generation, not header bytes
eh.owner: current_owner null without ACTIVEcatch else retains once; null retain/release noop; lastrefs one outside-lock owner destructor ticket thenfree; failedconstruction never completeTdestructor
eh.rethrow: owner_rethrow void/raises creates fresh currentthread facade captured currentglobal handler; bare rethrow_current inherits ACTIVEcaught snapshot; nocatch invokes terminate, no normal result
eh.terminate: explicit selects activecaught snapshot elseglobal; implicit establishes causingcatch; logicaluncaught count; handler return/throw aborts nonrecursive; actual callable fixedportable void()

journal.frontier: ABI construction slots/elements/parents/dependencies and monotonic completion ordinal, one ticket per phase
journal.cleanup: only committed subobjects destroyed in reverse completion order; in-progress constructors own partial children
journal.resume: complete typed live checkpoint, no repeated constructor/destructor/adapter effect

call.frontier: validate module/signature/nominal/capability and publish suspended caller before any callback
call.result: foreign RETURNED exposes target storage; conversion+required typed cleanup precede one portable normal commit
call.suspend: retain stage, exact adapter frame, foreign CPU snapshot, journals and leases; no native-call replay

pointer.frontier: registry-issued data provenance/code token; numeric address alone confers no authority
pointer.expose: record explicit address exposure; recover live authority only through admitted exposed object/generation/full origins; otherwise preserve non-dereferenceable numeric address
pointer.pure_poison: pure expose/recover propagate poison; unknown/unexposed/dead inttoptr is not an eager fault; dereference/call sink validates authority

atomic_flag.storage: one byte/alignment1; significant bit0; initialized false, remaining bits canonical zero
atomic_flag.progress: test/test_and_set/clear and hot lifetime guard are lock-free; no mutex/globalSC lock or dependence on paused guest worker
atomic_flag.order: same coherent process/shared-backing order as other atomics; SC may not become a separate flag-only total order
atomic_flag.lifetime: registered backing flag access class; aliases/foreign adapters use same atomic hot path; revocation prevents new admission without blocking flag operation
atomic_flag.lock_free: true for atomic_flag only; ordinary atomic<bool>/integer macros remain0

libm.finite: exact real mathematical function rounded once to destination binary format in selected rounding mode; stricter than approximate LLVM intrinsic bounds
libm.special: C23 domain/pole/signed-zero/infinity rules; first NaN quieted with payload/sign preserved; signaling NaN raises invalid
libm.sincospi: two results correctly rounded sin(pi*x),cos(pi*x) with exact mathematical pi*x argument reduction, never rounded pi multiplication
libm.errno: llvm_default/constrained preserve guest errno; c_fenv libm sets EDOM/ERANGE according to C source math-error contract
libm.fenv: llvm_default no environment changes; constrained/c_fenv merge flags before enabled trap, no result publication on trap
libm.powi: Full signed exponent width, exponent0 returns1 with no arithmetic; selected-bit multiply into1, shift magnitude right, square only when remaining nonzero; each executed multiply rounds destination, final reciprocal only negative; union only executed flags before single result frontier. This sequence overrides exact-real single-round finite policy for powi only.
libm.vector: c_fenv C libm is scalar only (no vector errno aggregation); floating_value scalar or fixed float vector; integer_value exponent has matched scalar/vector lane count; powi shares scalar integer exponent. Preserve lane poison, evaluate all defined lanes, union flags, diagnose once and publish complete result once; no source-visible prefix or compiler diagnostic-mask access.
libm.integer_round: lrint/llrint exact integer rounding selected mode, inexact only changed valid result; lround/llround nearest-away and never inexact; NaN/Inf/out-of-range returns concrete0 freeze refinement and invalid without inexact; flags merge once before result, never compound fptosi poison
libm.implementation: pure portable libm or software helper against this mathematical contract; host libm is not an implicit oracle
